# acecloud_routers (Data Source)

List all routers in the current region.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `routers` (Attributes List) List of routers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routers))

<a id="nestedatt--routers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routers`

Read-Only:

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Administrative state of the router.
- `external_gateway_network_id` (String) External gateway network UUID.
- `id` (String) Router UUID.
- `name` (String) Router name.
- `status` (String) Router status (e.g. ACTIVE, BUILD).
